description: This file defines a mock implementation of a cluster interface for testing purposes within the Mattermost server, including methods for message handling, cluster info retrieval, and cache invalidation.

classes.name: FakeClusterInterface
classes.description: A mock implementation of a cluster interface used for testing cluster communication and management within the Mattermost server.

methods.name: StartInterNodeCommunication
methods.description: Stub method to start inter-node communication.

methods.name: StopInterNodeCommunication
methods.description: Stub method to stop inter-node communication.

methods.name: RegisterClusterMessageHandler
methods.description: Registers a handler for cluster messages.

methods.name: HealthScore
methods.description: Returns a fixed health score of 0.

methods.name: GetClusterId
methods.description: Returns an empty string as cluster ID.

methods.name: IsLeader
methods.description: Indicates this node is not a leader.

methods.name: GetMyClusterInfo
methods.description: Returns nil for cluster info.

methods.name: GetClusterInfos
methods.description: Returns nil and no error for cluster info list.

methods.name: SendClusterMessage
methods.description: Appends a message to the internal message list.

methods.name: SendClusterMessageToNode
methods.description: Appends a message to the internal message list and returns nil.

methods.name: NotifyMsg
methods.description: Stub method for notification messages.

methods.name: GetClusterStats
methods.description: Returns nil for cluster stats and error.

methods.name: GetLogs
methods.description: Returns an empty list of logs.

methods.name: QueryLogs
methods.description: Returns an empty map of logs.

methods.name: GenerateSupportPacket
methods.description: Returns nil for support packet data.

methods.name: ConfigChanged
methods.description: Stub for handling config changes, returns nil error.

methods.name: SendClearRoleCacheMessage
methods.description: Invokes the cluster message handler to invalidate cache for roles.

methods.name: GetPluginStatuses
methods.description: Returns nil plugin statuses.

methods.name: GetMessages
methods.description: Returns the list of stored messages with read lock.

methods.name: SelectMessages
methods.description: Filters messages based on a condition.

methods.name: ClearMessages
methods.description: Clears the stored messages list.

methods.name: WebConnCountForUser
methods.description: Returns 0 and nil error for user connection count.

methods.name: GetWSQueues
methods.description: Returns nil for WebSocket queues.
